decision.summary: Implement truthful health/freshness response in isolated JJ development workspace; tests and exact candidate handoff; no production restart or deployment.
alternatives: Typed honest unavailable/unknown projection with actual evidence where present: selected.
Keep string-length success or make every route falsely green: rejected.
counterevidence: Core services and Zenoh router are running, so missing native telemetry is not proof all underlying services are down.
Forecast endpoint already reports UNKNOWN; avoid replacing it with synthetic confidence.
assumptions: Known service APIs may lack observation timestamps; those stay UNKNOWN rather than fabricate freshness.
decision.forecast: Negative controls will reject fallback payloads as freshness evidence in the development candidate.
decision.falsifier: Any missing native runtime, malformed payload, absent observation time or expired sample yields a positive freshness claim.
acceptance: Freeze exact source and compile with pinned already-realized dependencies.
Test live-like valid sample plus missing runtime, stub, malformed, empty, stale and future timestamp cases.
Private candidate HTTP response must reflect exact new source.
Preserve existing schema fields where meaningful; unsupported websocket liveness unknown.
Provide source hashes and test invocations for independent review.
decision.rollback: Keep deployed capsule/main unchanged; preserve own isolated candidate on failure.
decision.reviewer: Codex independent source and behavioral review after AGY implementation.
decision.budget: One bounded AGY implementation and independent reviewer; local realized tools, no new packages or production effects.
residuals: Full native telemetry routing and predictor observation wiring may remain separate work.
Release remains separately governed under current Telegram/admission plans.
